subject.title: Feature: Inject context window % into system prompt runtime section

question: Should OpenClaw expose passive context-window usage in the system-prompt Runtime line, and what freshness/format contract should that field use?
rationale: The code path is clear, but choosing volatile per-turn prompt metadata affects prompt semantics, cache behavior, stale snapshot handling, and broader runtime self-context direction.

options.title: Approve bounded Runtime context metadata
options.body: Add a small context field below the cache boundary using only fresh or explicitly documented previous-turn usage, with focused tests for stale, compaction, and model-switch cases.

options.title: Keep explicit inspection only
options.body: Leave context usage on /context, /status, session_status, and UI/status surfaces, then close or update this issue once maintainers confirm passive prompt metadata is not desired.

options.title: Fold into broader runtime self-context
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89537 the design owner only if it explicitly accepts context-window usage as part of the runtime self-context contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Runtime context metadata
recommendation.body: Add a small context field below the cache boundary using only fresh or explicitly documented previous-turn usage, with focused tests for stale, compaction, and model-switch cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history match for the Runtime prompt path and likely product owner for a prompt-contract decision.
